GEOID = state FIPS + county FIPS. This must be the key, not the name: county names repeat heavily across states (30+ states have a Washington County). Our current crosswalk stores names only, giving just 1956 distinct names for 3222 counties.
Full legal name with suffix: "Palm Beach County", "Orleans Parish", "Anchorage Municipality". Suffix varies by state — do not assume "County".
Suffix stripped ("Palm Beach"). Required to normalise cash_buyers.coverage[], which stores bare names, against canonical records.

USPS preferred city name — the decision you made. Matches what is printed on the property address, which is what investors type. NOT a municipal boundary: the ZIPs labelled "Lake Worth" cover unincorporated Palm Beach County well beyond Lake Worth Beach city limits.
